scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is existential for a specific local V-dent family on a \(C^2\) convex boundary. It does not claim that every small dent fails, does not give a sharp finite dent-size threshold, and does not prove Larson's full proposed piecewise-smooth if-and-only-if criterion. The proof is analytic: a positive linear increase in the dented cell's average absolute curvature is compared with a quadratic increase for a homothetic inner competitor. A unit-circle calculation was used only as a sanity check. Targeted literature searches found no later indexed statement of the same smooth-dent result, but an unindexed note or differently phrased treatment remains a residual originality risk.
title: Arbitrarily small V-dents destroy the DNA inequality on every \(C^2\) convex curve
